queries.query: Does Article 5(1)(b) of Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/301 support this requirement: Submit within 72 hours after the initial notification, even if the incident status or handling has not changed

Which provision of Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/301 is materially necessary for this requirement but absent from the existing mapping: Submit within 72 hours after the initial notification, even if the incident status or handling has not changed

item.control_statement: Submit within 72 hours after the initial notification, even if the incident status or handling has not changed
